Mixed purées

Pear and banana with oats

Körtés banán zabbal

6 months+ Adjusted 20 min 2 portions

Serve warm and smooth. This is the biscuit-free version, and it contains gluten.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 20 g fine porridge oats (treat as gluten)
  • 180 ml water
  • 120 g ripe pear (prepared weight, peeled and cored)
  • 1/2 ripe banana (peeled)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Peel and core the pear and cook it in a splash of water until soft.
  2. Stir the oats into the water and cook until soft and smooth, about 5 minutes.
  3. Mash the banana and stir it into the warm oats with the pear.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Do not add biscuit crumbs or sugar.

Adjusted

The usual topping is a sweet shop biscuit, which this bowl does not need. Oats count as gluten here.

Use fine oats cooked soft with pear and banana, instead of biscuit crumbs. Leave the sweet crumb topping out.
